title: Crashed when hit breakpoint
body:
### Summary

I'm trying to use XDebug (PHP Debugger) in Helix but as soon I hit a breakpoint it is crashing. (Full backtrace is included in reproduction steps)

Here is my debuggger config in `~/.config/helix/languages.toml`
```toml
[[language]]
name = "php"
language-server = { command = "phpactor", args = ["language-server", "-vvv"] }

[language.debugger]
name = "xdebug"
command = "node"
args = ["/home/hasnayeen/.vscode/extensions/xdebug.php-debug-1.29.0/out/phpDebug.js"]
transport = "tcp"
port-arg = "--server={}"

[[language.debugger.templates]]
name = "listen"
request = "launch"
completion = [ { name = "binary", completion = "filename" } ]
args = { log = "true" }
```
I'm using [vscode-php-debug](https://github.com/xdebug/vscode-php-debug) vscode extension for XDebug.

The panic is happening at this line https://github.com/helix-editor/helix/blob/758bace2210e83dacadd755c3f97bb62ad259a73/helix-view/src/handlers/dap.rs#L230

Let me know if any more info is needed

### Reproduction Steps

<!-- Ideally provide a key sequence and/or asciinema.org recording. --> 

I tried this:

1. Opened a php app in helix
2. Launched debug target
3. Set breakpoint
4. Visit the app in the browser 

I expected this to happen:
Execution paused at the breakpoint
